name: Cabanas & Marceline Market Warm Asian White Rice Congee Porridge (Standalone)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Cabanas / Disney Treasure · Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Simmered for hours until white rice breaks down into a silky, starch-rich gruel—10/10 gut-soothing flare rescue available every morning at the buffet soup/hot cereal station.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ladle a bowl of plain hot white rice congee, season with a splash of tamari/soy sauce and shredded chicken or hard-boiled egg, and skip the chili oil, raw scallions, and fried shallots.
watchOuts: Strictly skip the chili oil, raw green onions, and peanuts on the condiment tray
